title: The existing scheme-module pullback functor is strong monoidal
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. Equip the categories of module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] with their sheaf tensor products [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. Let $f^*:\operatorname{Mod}(\mathcal O_Y)\to\operatorname{Mod}(\mathcal O_X)$ be the existing scheme-module pullback functor, left adjoint to module pushforward. Then $f^*$ has a strong monoidal structure: its unit comparison and its natural tensor comparisons $f^*(M\otimes N)\cong f^*M\otimes f^*N$ are isomorphisms satisfying the associativity and both unit coherence diagrams.

proof.text: Use the already proved Scheme.Modules.pullbackMonoidal instance in the recorded source. Its construction gives the presheaf pullback followed by sheafification its composite monoidal structure. The natural isomorphism SheafOfModules.sheafificationCompPullback identifies this composite with sheafification followed by the scheme-module pullback. Since sheafification is a monoidal localization, Localization.Monoidal.functorMonoidalOfComp descends the composite structure to scheme-module pullback. That construction supplies the invertible unit and tensor comparisons and their coherence laws. No additional Lean theorem or postponed proof is introduced here.
